content.short: CryptoRaggies is a Cardano NFT art and gaming project with playable collectibles and community rewards.
content.description: CryptoRaggies is an original Cardano NFT project that combines collectible artwork with casual gaming and community rewards. Its NFTs are designed to be playable inside the project's games, giving holders more utility than static ownership. The team has released playable alpha builds, regular updates, and leaderboard competitions that reward winners with ADA and the RAG token. CryptoRaggies is focused on approachable gameplay, community engagement, and long-term Cardano NFT participation on chain.
